subject.name: Language & Literature (English)
subject.programme: IB DP English A: Language & Literature SL/HL (first exam 2021)
subject.examPattern: IB DP – graded 1–7; recommended 150 h SL / 240 h HL; exams May (Hindi May only). HL: Paper 1 Guided textual analysis 2 h 15, 40 marks (35%) – both unseen non-literary passages; Paper 2 Comparative essay 1 h 45, 30 marks (25%) – 1 of 4 questions; HL essay 1,200–1,500 words (20%); Individual Oral 15 min, 40 marks (20%). SL: P1 1 of 2 passages (35%), P2 35%, IO 30%.
